summary: Researched three qlib China daily acquisition routes (official GetData CLI, chenditc/investment_data community release, dump-your-own). Installed pyqlib 0.9.7 in a worktree .venv on Python 3.11.2 arm64. Official CLI download succeeded but the pack ends 2020-09-25; community release 2026-07-05 was written to ~/.qlib/qlib_data/cn_data (813M, 193s). Smoke validation: calendar 2000-01-04..2026-07-03, 6114 instruments, csi300 ~2y panel 145309 rows with ~0.17% NaN on OHLCV. Wrote findings and v0.1 demo recommendation to docs/research/qlib-cn-data.md only.

files_changed.purpose: Acquisition path comparison, measured install/download/smoke numbers, v0.1 demo recommendation, open risks

self_test.cmd: python3.11 -m venv .venv && source .venv/bin/activate && pip install pyqlib && python -c "import qlib; print(qlib.__version__)"

deviations: Official GetData was expected to be fully disabled per README/#1547; on this machine it downloaded successfully but the pack is stale (ends 2020-09-25). Primary pack used for smoke is the community release, as recommended.
Smoke script required kernels=1 and a file-based entrypoint; stdin python -c/heredoc hit macOS multiprocessing spawn FileNotFoundError on <stdin>.
open_questions: Exact semantic definition of $adjclose vs $close/$factor in the community pack (cash CNY vs internal scale) needs adapter-side unit tests before emitting prices to the kernel.
Whether v0.1 should pin a specific investment_data release tag (e.g. 2026-07-05) for bit-for-bit reproducibility instead of latest.
notes_for_referee: Primary evidence in docs/research/qlib-cn-data.md. Data lives at ~/.qlib/qlib_data/cn_data (813M, last day 2026-07-03). Official probe left at ~/.qlib/qlib_data/cn_data_official_probe for comparison only (stale through 2020-09-25). Only repo file changed: the research doc.
